meta.name: Taavod — Revolve direction
meta.description: Native macOS learning and career workspace. Deep black and white adaptive themes, restrained purple emphasis, exact typography, truthful charts, and the approved Shih Tzu design.
source_references: User-provided Revolve dashboard: primary visual benchmark, 2026-10-23
User-provided dark campaign dashboard: layered charts and compact controls
User-provided CampusHub and Dei dashboards: asymmetric composition and clear task cards
User-provided Zentra and Nexus dashboards: readable data hierarchy
User-provided dashboard motion video: short stagger, then chart reveal

color.palette_type: Adaptive near-black/charcoal and off-white/white; restrained purple emphasis

primary.role: Primary text in dark mode; #17191B in light mode

secondary.role: Dark card surface; #FFFFFF in light mode

accent.role: Active chart data and controls; #7051D4 in light mode

neutral.usage: Black canvas, charcoal panels, fine rims, high-contrast text; invert thoughtfully for light mode

surface.elevated: Native regular Liquid Glass for floating controls

color.contrast_strategy: Solid reading surfaces, clear primary/secondary text, visible keyboard focus; color never carries meaning alone

typography.font_style_notes: Plain, precise system typography with optical sizing, restrained medium weights, tight large-heading tracking and tabular chart values.

spacing.content_density: Compact navigation and charts; comfortable reading and editing

layout.grid_system: Native SwiftUI adaptive rows and grids with collapsible 228pt sidebar
layout.columns: Dominant activity chart with weekly task column; separate spacious learning and coding workspaces
layout.alignment_tendency: Consistent left edges, asymmetric information hierarchy, no overlapping fixed-height content

shape.divider_style: Fine neutral rules only where grouping requires them

elevation.shadow_style: Minimal on cards; broad, soft separation only on floating coach
elevation.depth_cues: Near-flat charcoal surfaces, very subtle 2.5% upper-left light, inset controls

iconography.style: SF Symbols regular strokes with muted inset tiles

motion.entrance_pattern: One initial dashboard stagger: 8pt translation and opacity, 50ms between groups; chart clip reveal follows
motion.philosophy: Feedback and state clarity; no delayed keyboard navigation, no perpetual decorative loops, reduced-motion equivalent included

components.button_style: Legible pill primary actions, compact native controls, visible press state
components.input_style: Inset neutral fields with clear focus and labels
components.card_style: Near-flat neutral rounded panels with fine rims; sparse semantic tints
components.navigation_pattern: Collapsible native sidebar, explicit active row, grouped workspace/career navigation and breadcrumb
components.modal_style: Native sheets; one Liquid Glass surface for floating coach
components.list_style: Aligned, scannable rows with actual counts and clear actions
components.component_notes: SwiftUI and AppKit own the visible interface. Native Swift Charts display saved records only.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A precise personal learning and career cockpit

visual_language.ornamentation: Subtle surface light and one accent
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around headings and between work areas
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Dominant readable chart and next action; supporting metrics stay compact
visual_language.focal_strategy: Actionable next step plus truthful activity chart
visual_language.contrast_level: high text contrast, subtle surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: Detailed plush Shih Tzu artwork; clean UI surfaces

composition.flow_direction: Sidebar to page context, next action, activity and weekly work
composition.grouping_strategy: Related data and actions share a clearly titled panel
composition.negative_space_role: reduce visual noise and preserve focus

imagery.photo_treatment: Owner-provided dog photos serve as identity references only; raw photos are excluded from source
imagery.illustration_style: Approved cream-and-tan Shih Tzu with dark floppy ears, white crown and short muzzle; premium cinematic 3D render
imagery.graphic_elements: Purple chart emphasis, restrained neutral tiles, native glass controls
imagery.pattern_usage: No decorative particle or noise overlays
imagery.image_shape: Centered chest-up portrait for video and a separately framed transparent icon cutout

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Explicit states, selected-row treatment, chart details and direct actions
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Near-imperceptible control feedback and chart value tooltip

overview.fallback_strategy: Approved static Shih Tzu artwork while video is unavailable or reduced motion is enabled
overview.primary_technology: SwiftUI, native Liquid Glass and Swift Charts; AVFoundation cursor-scrub component pending approved motion takes

background_effects.description: Solid black or off-white canvas; subtle local panel light only

3d_elements.type: Development SceneKit dog rig retained in source
3d_elements.description: Live scene is development artwork. The approved rendered dog is the visible brand; video integration awaits suitable takes.

params.renderer: Static approved render in main UI
params.lighting: Baked cinematic lighting in approved render
params.interaction_model: Native cursor scrubbing pending final direction clips

shader_effects.description: No custom full-screen shaders; native glass only

cursor_effects.description: System cursor; chart hover details. Planned dog gaze responds inside the app window only.

image_effects.type: Static portrait and transparent icon cutout
image_effects.description: Approved Shih Tzu identity preserved across dashboard and Icon Composer; native video scrub prepared separately
image_effects.technology: SwiftUI image rendering; Icon Composer; AVFoundation component

params.shadow_type: Native control depth and soft coach shadow

canvas_drawings.description: No web canvas or Pixi renderer in the native product

svg_animations.description: No SVG animation runtime in the native product

visual_effects.composite_notes: Revolve is the primary visual benchmark, with native Apple behavior and Liquid Glass on controls. Charts contain actual saved data. The approved Shih Tzu render supersedes the previous clay portrait. Still references describe appearance, not observed motion.
